cohorts.name: Repeat pre-move
cohorts.desc: Opened before outsized moves on 3+ independent occasions, and the hit rate on all its large fresh opens beats the base rate by a margin that survives a multiple-testing check.

cohorts.name: Proven speculator
cohorts.desc: Profitable 90-day record after fees (20+ closes, win rate 55%+, profit factor 1.3+), holds positions long enough to copy. No proof of advance knowledge.

cohorts.name: Fresh concentrated
cohorts.desc: Account under 14 days old with one concentrated position of $1M+. An anomaly worth watching, unproven.

cohorts.name: Unproven: found after the fact
cohorts.desc: Found after the fact as a pre-move opener, live or in the backtest. A hit found by looking back is not evidence of skill or information.

cohorts.name: Hedger / market maker
cohorts.desc: Mostly maker fills, very frequent orders, very short holds, or the position is offset elsewhere. Not a directional signal.

cohorts.name: Unproven
cohorts.desc: In the registry but no qualifying evidence yet (e.g. a fresh account that aged, or a speculator whose stats lapsed).

scorecard.note: Strictly prospective: only alerts emitted live by this collector, measured from the mark price when the alert was logged, before spread, fees, funding and delay. Event alerts are excluded. Small samples mean nothing yet.

method: Events: a market is flagged when its move since the start of a sharp run (at most 12 hourly candles, start refined to 5-minute candles) is at least 5% AND at least 3 daily sigmas of its own last ~45 days. start_ts is the inflection, not detection time.

Openers: wallets whose position in that market went from flat to the move's direction in the 48h before start_ts. Open time is found from hourly funding rows (which carry position size) and confirmed from ordinary AND TWAP fills with startPosition = 0; first_px is that first fill. Wallets that already closed are included with realized PnL from their closing fills.

Candidates come from our own trade tape (who was buying before the move), leaderboard day/week PnL toppers, wallets already in the registry, and (best-effort, last 24h only) a free third-party wallet ranking. The leaderboard misses small new accounts, and the tape only covers markets and hours it was running.
Mid-move chasers (opened after start_ts, or after the price had already run >= max(3%, 30% of the move) in the prior 6h) are shown but never counted as hits.

Tiers: post-event discovery can never exceed WATCH. HIGH needs >= 3 independent pre-move hits AND >= 6 independent large fresh opens whose hit rate beats the base rate with a binomial p <= 0.003 and expected false positives < 0.5 across all wallets tested, positive mean 24h return across hits and misses, median hold >= 1.5h, and no hedge. An empty HIGH list is expected early on.

Base rate: in a backtest of 440 sampled leaderboard wallets, large fresh opens preceded a big move 8.4% of the time versus 8.2% for random timing, and no wallet reached HIGH. That 8.4% is the chance rate (floor 8%) until 50+ opens are scored live. Wallets loaded from that backtest are shown as WATCH; backtest numbers never raise a tier.

A scored large fresh open = opened from flat, peak size within 6h >= max($250k, 5% of equity). Hit = price touched +X in its direction before -X within 48h, X = max(2%, 1 daily sigma x sqrt(2)). Same-direction opens within 24h count as one trial.

MEDIUM (proven speculator) is a 90-day after-fee track record (20+ closes, win rate 55%+, PF 1.3+, 90d PnL > 0, equity $250k+). It says nothing about advance knowledge. Fill history is capped by Hyperliquid (latest ~10k fills); truncated records are labelled.

NOISE: mostly maker fills, > 60 orders/day, median hold < 1h, or offset positions (same underlying across dexs, BTC/ETH pair). A big position is not a signal by itself: it can be a hedge of something held off Hyperliquid.

Alerts compare each tracked wallet's positions on every dex with the previous cycle. A wallet's first observation never alerts; a failed dex poll carries the prior state forward. HIGH alerts are downgraded when price already moved more than max(2%, 0.75 x 1h sigma) from the wallet's entry. Wallets funded by the same counterparty are grouped as one entity for de-dup and clusters.

Scorecard is strictly prospective: forward returns at 1h/4h/24h/72h measured from the mark price when the alert was logged, before spread, fees, funding and delay. net_h24 subtracts a 0.09% round-trip fee and the quoted spread. Nothing here proves anyone traded on inside information.
